ALL that certain lot, parcel or tract of land, situate and lying in the Borough of Haddonfield, County of Camden and State of New Jersey being more particularly described as follows:

Beginning at a point in the Southwesterly right of way line of Washington Avenue (40 feet wide) where intersected by the Northerly line of Lot 12.06 as shown on Plan hereinafter mentioned, said point being South 25 degrees 06 minutes 00 seconds East, 156.69 feet from the intersection of said right of way line of Washington Avenue with the Southeasterly line of Lot 12, Block 76 and running; thence

(1) along said Southwesterly line of Washington Avenue, South 25 degrees 06 minutes 00 seconds East, 20.07 feet to a point in the division line of Lots 12.06 and 12.07 on Plan hereinafter mentioned; thence

(2) along said division line, South 61 degrees 23 minutes 09 seconds West, 69.88 feet to a point in the Northeasterly line of Lot 12.12, Block 76; thence

(3) Along the Northeasterly line of Lot 12.12 and Lot 12.11, North 28 degrees 36 minutes 51 seconds West, 20.03 feet to a point in the division line of Lots 12.05 and 12.06 on Plan hereinafter mentioned; thence

(4) Along said division line, North 61 degrees 23 minutes 09 seconds East, 71.11 feet to the point and place of beginning.
